function.name: find_hotel

**Pet‑friendly train stations in Miami** | Transit system | Station (in Miami) | Pet policy (on trains) | Notes | |-----------------|--------------------|------------------------|-------| | **Metrorail** (Miami‑Dade Transit) | • **Miami Central** (downtown)
• **Brickell**
• **Downtown**
• **Miami Airport** (MIA)
• **Miami Beach** (via the Metrorail extension) | Small pets (dogs, cats, etc.) are allowed **if they are in a carrier** or **leashed**. They must be kept under the seat or in the designated pet area. No loose pets are permitted. | All Metrorail stations are equipped with elevators, escalators, and accessible platforms. The transit authority encourages pet owners to bring a carrier and keep pets quiet during the ride. | | **Tri‑Rail** (South Florida Regional Transportation Authority) | • **Miami Central** (downtown)
• **Miami Airport** (MIA)
• **Miami Beach** (via the Tri‑Rail extension) | Pets are allowed **only in carriers** that fit under the seat. No loose pets. | Tri‑Rail trains have a “pet area” on each car. The policy is the same as Metrorail’s. | ### How to confirm the policy 1. **Visit the official websites** * [Miami‑Dade Transit – Metrorail](https://www.miamidade.gov/transit/metrorail.asp) * [South Florida Regional Transportation Authority – Tri‑Rail](https://www.tri-rail.com/) 2. **Call the customer service lines** * Metrorail: 305‑361‑4000 * Tri‑Rail: 305‑361‑4000 (same line) 3. **Check the “Pet Policy” section** on each site for the most up‑to‑date rules. ### Quick tips for traveling with pets in Miami - **Carrier size:** Must fit under the seat; typically no larger than 18 × 12 × 12 inches (45 × 30 × 30 cm). - **Leash:** If the pet is not in a carrier, it must be on a leash no longer than 6 ft (1.8 m). - **Cleanliness:** Bring a small bag for waste disposal. - **Timing:** Avoid peak hours (7–9 am, 4–6 pm) if possible; trains are less crowded. ### Suggested stations for pet owners - **Miami Central** – The main hub for both Metrorail and Tri‑Rail, with easy access to downtown and the airport. - **Brickell** – Convenient for the financial district; pet‑friendly trains run frequently. - **Miami Airport (MIA)** – Direct connection to the airport; pet carriers are allowed on all flights. If you’re planning a trip that involves a train ride, double‑check the carrier dimensions and the latest pet policy before you go. Happy travels!
